confirm.title: Claim ONNAIS lock
confirm.description: Found {name} ({address}). Put it into pairing mode now (press 3, 3, then the checkmark), then submit. A new owner secret is generated and stored only in this Home Assistant install.

user.title: Add an ONNAIS lock
user.description: Pick a discovered lock. Leave the secret blank to pair a factory-fresh lock (you'll need to put it in pairing mode). If this lock was already claimed by this project's own tooling or a previous Home Assistant setup, paste its existing secret here instead to import it without pairing again.

error.already_bound: This lock rejected the factory-default secret, meaning it's already bound (for example to the official ONNAIS app). Unbind it there first, or enter its existing secret manually.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the lock. Make sure it's in pairing mode and within Bluetooth range of this Home Assistant install (or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy).
error.invalid_secret: That secret was rejected by the lock. Double check it, or leave it blank to claim the lock fresh.

abort.already_configured: This lock is already set up.
abort.no_devices_found: No ONNAIS locks found. Make sure the lock is powered and within Bluetooth range.
abort.not_visible: That lock isn't currently visible to Home Assistant's Bluetooth stack.

set_temp_password.name: Set temporary passcode
set_temp_password.description: Programs a keypad passcode into one of the lock's 10 temp-password slots.

delete_temp_password.name: Delete temporary passcode
delete_temp_password.description: Clears one of the lock's temp-password slots.

begin_add_key_fob.name: Begin adding a key fob
begin_add_key_fob.description: Puts the lock into fob-enrollment mode.

delete_key_fob.name: Delete key fob
delete_key_fob.description: Clears a programmed key fob slot.

unbind.name: Unbind (factory reset owner secret)
unbind.description: Destructive. Resets the lock's owner secret back to the vendor default.
